verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the underlying mechanism — agents load only each skill's name/description at startup to decide relevance ([skills-cli-docs-3]), and a runtime probe shows each skill ships a distinct trigger description that can be reviewed before install ([skills-cli-probe-rt-2]). However, there's no evidence of guidance/tooling for authors to 'engineer' descriptions for correct activation, no hands-on validation that the right skill actually fires at the right moment in practice, and community comments raise unresolved questions about how skills are surfaced/ranked rather than confirming activation accuracy. Missing for 10: documented best-practices or tooling for writing effective trigger descriptions, and independent hands-on evidence that automatic activation reliably selects the correct skill.
